items.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I don’t think if I compared Dizzy Gillespie to Mozart. ... To Mozart. The European composer, sorry, my accent.

ctx.x: The word, the term “genius” I think it’s overused. Do you consider Dizzy and Charlie Parker to be geniuses?
I think that I’m not at the musical level to give an opinion about that because I don’t think, maybe the word genius in a sense, I don’t think if I compared Dizzy Gillespie to Mozart.
